title: Project P.I.T.T. Elevator Code — Why 2640 Doesn't Work & How to Find Yours
description: 2640 is not a universal elevator code; the four save-specific digits are revealed by using a Keycard plus UV Light to read your save's hidden clues.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Elevator Code — Why 2640 Doesn't Work & How to Find Yours
quickAnswer: Do not treat 2640 as a fixed elevator code; it's from one playthrough — use your Keycard plus UV Light to reveal the four save-specific digits, then enter them in machine-unlock order: Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly.

facts.label: Why 2640 fails
facts.value: Reported from one specific playthrough; current players report 2640 does not work.

facts.label: Your code
facts.value: The four-digit elevator/keypad code is tied to the current save and must be discovered in your own playthrough.

facts.label: What you need
facts.value: A Keycard for elevator/keypad access and a UV Light to reveal the four save-specific digits; do not guess locations.

facts.label: Entry order
facts.value: Map the revealed digits to the four manual production machines and enter them in this machine-unlock order: Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly.
